summary: Iteration 29 — Dealer dashboard navigation redesign + Edit Printers/Papers/Consumables. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest PASS — PUT /api/supplier/printers/{id}, PUT /api/supplier/papers/{id}, PUT /api/supplier/consumables/{id} all accept scalar-only payloads (price, stock, gsm) WITHOUT image_url/image_urls and the existing image fields are preserved end-to-end (verified via /supplier/{printers,papers,consumables}/mine GET re-fetch). 403 guards for non-supplier (admin) confirmed on printers and papers PUT endpoints. FRONTEND: Frontend Playwright run could NOT authenticate the stored iteration-28 supplier credentials (qa.ui.it28.117dbf@example.com) — Supabase /token returned 400; the account appears to have been rotated/purged or password changed. As a result no live UI verification of the new full-width dealer tab bar, tab switching, action-area buttons or clickable stat cards was performed in this run. However, exhaustive source-code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/SupplierDashboard.jsx confirms: (a) DealerTabBar component renders full-width [data-testid='catalog-tabs'] directly above the dark hero (line 547), (b) all 10 tab keys are defined with pastel bg/bgActive/accent colors (lines 35-46) and rendered as buttons with data-testid='tab-{key}' (line 59), (c) per-tab action panels exist for printers/papers/consumables/toners with the required add-/bulk-/edit- testids (lines 641-670, 793-797), (d) stat cards are buttons wired to goStat(key) handler that switches catalog and sets the filter; testids supplier-stat-listings/active/orders/pending exist (line 625), (e) listings-filter-clear chip (line 802) and orders-filter-clear chip (line 686) render conditional on listingFilter/orderFilter, (f) selectTab clears both filters on manual tab click (line 343), (g) Edit Printers/Papers/Consumables buttons dispatch tc-open-edit-printer/paper/consumable CustomEvents picked up by PrinterListings/PaperListings/ConsumableListings, (h) navbar-categories is intentionally hidden for sellers in Header.jsx (carry-over from iteration 28). Backend tests prove the edit-flow persistence and image preservation. Main agent should manually verify the frontend tab switching + clickable stat cards using a fresh approved supplier or by rotating the iteration-28 test password.

(2) Clicking each tab swaps the content below: Printers→add-printer-cta-btn, Papers→add-paper-cta-btn, Consumables→add-consumable-cta-btn, Bulk→bulk-hub, D2D→d2d-panel, OEM→oem-panel, Orders→orders table, Toners→add-listing-btn. (3) Clicking supplier-stat-active jumps to Toners tab with listings-filter-clear chip visible; supplier-stat-pending jumps to Orders tab with orders-filter-clear chip; clicking any tab manually clears both chips. (4) Edit Printers/Papers/Consumables buttons open the BulkUploadGeneric grid in edit mode pre-loaded with existing rows; saving a price-only edit issues PUT /api/supplier/{printers|papers|consumables}/{id} and persists after reload WITHOUT wiping images.

Refresh /app/memory/test_credentials.md with a fresh long-lived approved supplier (e.g. seed via backend script) so the next testing agent can run end-to-end UI Playwright without redoing signup+approval each time.
(Carry-over) Auto-dismiss the 'Set your location' coachmark and cookie banner on first load — they continue to block automation clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /supplier/printers/{id}, PUT /supplier/papers/{id}, PUT /supplier/consumables/{id} all use selective `if payload.X is not None` updates plus model_dump(exclude_unset=True) — image_url/image_urls are not in `upd` unless explicitly sent, so scalar edits correctly preserve images. Verified end-to-end.

Printer PUT has a retry loop that drops unknown columns by checking `if k in msg` against the Postgres error string (line 4795). This works but is brittle — a future column name that coincidentally substring-matches another would be silently dropped. Suggest using PostgREST error codes / column-name parsing instead.

DealerTabBar (SupplierDashboard.jsx 49-78) is well-isolated and uses inline styles + onMouseEnter/Leave for hover. The flex-1 min-w-[118px] layout will wrap horizontally on narrow viewports via overflow-x-auto — good for mobile.
selectTab (line 343) clears both listingFilter AND orderFilter on every manual tab click — matches spec: 'Clicking a tab manually clears these filters'.

goStat (line 345) correctly routes the 4 stat cards: listings→toners/all, active→toners/active, orders→orders/all, pending→orders/pending. data-testid uses lowercase k (line 625) which produces supplier-stat-listings/active/orders/pending — matches spec.

Edit Printers/Papers/Consumables emit CustomEvents (tc-open-edit-printer/paper/consumable) listened to by the respective listings components, which then render <BulkUploadGeneric editMode initialRows=...>. Per-row PUT/POST pattern in BulkUploadGeneric is sound but the per-row 401/403 handling should be re-verified after token refresh (out of scope here).
server.py is 5351 lines — recommend splitting into routers (carry-over).
